title: Income-tax Act — Section 25 (Amounts not deductible from house property)

content.overview: Section 25 disallows interest chargeable under the Act that is payable outside India without the required tax deduction or an agent arrangement.
content.glance: Section 25 disallows interest chargeable under the Act that is payable outside India without the required tax deduction or an agent arrangement.
content.study: Interest chargeable under the Act that is payable outside India, on which tax has not been paid or deducted and in respect of which there is no agent in India, is not deductible in computing house-property income.

sections.heading: Operative rule
sections.body: Section 25 disallows interest chargeable under the Act that is payable outside India without the required tax deduction or an agent arrangement.
